reference: Petrache et al., Phys. Rev. C 93, 064305 (2016)

summary.non_wobbling_status: Despite measuring 75% to 83% E2 character in four separate Delta I = 1 transitions, Petrache et al. explicitly refrain from claiming wobbling or chirality in 134Ce.
summary.methodological_rule: High E2 purity (75%-83%) in Delta I = 1 linking lines is NOT unique evidence of wobbling motion; it can arise naturally from single-particle M1 matrix element cancellation or shape coexistence. Only absolute DSAM/RDDS lifetimes directly demonstrating B(E2)_out >= 20-50 W.u. can establish collective transverse wobbling.
